concepts.proposed_markdown: - [[source-braintree-docs-guides-fastlane-advanced-option]] - Braintree Fastlane advanced-options route for conditional saved-card versus card-field rendering, client payment-token/device-data handoff to merchant-server processing, shipping and store-pickup safeguards, and optional vaulting; not direct PayPal Orders API or payment-outcome evidence
warnings: Keep this Braintree transaction.sale/customer/payment-method route distinct from the direct PayPal Orders API Fastlane pattern already described on the concept page.
A Fastlane paymentToken is an input to later server processing, not proof of authorization, capture, settlement or funding; vaulting is an optional separate server action.

Treat the 2026-09-16 page as website snapshot evidence, separate from exact-version GitHub implementation evidence and not proof of current Fastlane availability, merchant enablement, buyer eligibility, SDK support or live execution.
Do not convert the page's misleading US-address heading into a US-only shipping claim; its body limits billing addresses to the US while allowing merchant-supported shipping destinations.
